acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test test_readsExpectedIconCount verifies the icon count from the framework's icons.json (excluding spinners).
Test test_excludesSpinnerIcons verifies that spinner-type icons are absent from the definitions.
Test test_normalisesIconIDs verifies that hyphens/spaces in icon IDs are converted to underscores.
Test test_definitionsAreSortedByID verifies alphabetical sort order by ID.
Test test_returnsEmptyOnMissingFile verifies that a non-existent JSON path returns an empty list without throwing.
Test test_iconDefinitionProperties verifies getID(), getIconName(), and getIconType() on an IconDefinition.

comments.note: Class structure and conventions are an excellent match to IconBuilderTest.php — identical setUp/tearDown patterns, same fixture path resolution, same temp-file cleanup idiom. Consistent with the broader test suite style.
test_returnsEmptyOnMissingFile verifies both getIcons() and countIcons() return empty/zero — good dual-assertion pattern that catches any divergence between the two convenience methods.
Using isolated tmp JSON files for test_normalisesIconIDs and test_iconDefinitionProperties is the right approach — decouples tests from real icons.json content changes and makes intent explicit.
test_excludesSpinnerIcons correctly references the class constant IconsReader::EXCLUDED_ICON_SPINNER rather than a magic string — good maintainability practice.

No behavioral changes were warranted. The tempnam prefix 'icons_reader_test_' is slightly verbose but consistent with the file's purpose; no renaming was needed. All code reviewed without modification — file declared in artifacts as actively reviewed.

[documentation-forward] IconsReaderTest.php class-level docblock mentions 'graceful handling of missing files' and 'IconDefinition property accessors' but does not reference the normalisation contract (hyphens/spaces → underscores) or the spinner-exclusion constant (EXCLUDED_ICON_SPINNER). A brief sentence in the class docblock referencing these two invariants would help future contributors understand the key behaviours under test at a glance.

[documentation-forward] createTempJsonFile() docblock describes the method accurately, but does not mention that the returned path already has a '.json' extension appended (tempnam result + '.json'). A note there would prevent confusion when future tests pass the path to other helpers.
